prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Thanks  for another upgrade! Let the vodka flow!
Delta: You bet, have a great weekend. 😊 *TBT

Customer: Well...that was a bust! But  #SkyClub Staffmember Chen (one of my favs) went to bat for me! Thanks! Now I'm #1 on ALL #Upgrade Lists! https://t.co/GBheg46hux
Delta: Please enjoy your flight.  *HCK

Customer: My upgrade got upgraded... Unwinding with a glass of red in first class. Cheers to #CargoFS17 and #ElevateCargo 🍷 Thanks
Delta: Whoa! You are on a roll! Happy to have you with us again, Skylar. *HDG

Customer: A beautiful foggy morning  and thanks for the upgrade  https://t.co/j4TA9fLqh4
Delta: Happy to be of assistance. Glad to see you flying in style this murky morning. *ASK

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: praise):
""".  Cheers and thanks for the upgrade to Dublin!! Unexpected and appreciated!! #2millionsoon https://t.co/KoDdFKMmXp"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Delighted to hear you’re enjoying the surprise upgrade to Dublin! Safe travels and cheers to many more miles ahead. ✈️😊
